text: dsh-plugin-subhub 是面向 DSH Web 的第三方订阅模型插件：它将用户通过浏览器设备码授权的 OpenAI/ChatGPT、xAI Grok 和 GitHub Copilot 订阅接入模型目录与选择器，并在设置页集中显示登录状态。登录后可同步账户可用模型、推理等级与图片输入能力；OpenAI 适配器还提供 generate_image 工具，可根据提示生成图片或编辑对话中的最近一张图片。插件以各提供方适配器连接订阅服务，配置支持凭据文件位置和模型/API 服务地址等选项。使用前需要相应服务的订阅账户并完成登录；交互式登录通过浏览器设备授权，凭据由插件存入本地文件。

dsh-plugin-subhub connects OpenAI, Grok, and Copilot subscription accounts to the DSH Web model picker through browser sign-in. Its settings show login status and available models. The OpenAI provider also offers image generation and editing. Credentials are stored in plugin-owned local files.

怎样用浏览器授权登录，不用自己填 API key？
我需要在设置页查看订阅账户能用哪些模型和推理档位。
希望每个订阅提供方的登录凭据保存在我指定的本地路径。
Can I use my ChatGPT or Grok subscription models in DSH?
I want to connect a subscription account through browser sign-in instead of entering an API key.
Let me generate a new image or edit the latest conversation image with my OpenAI subscription.
dsh-plugin-subhub 的订阅登录：在设置页启动浏览器设备码授权并轮询登录结果，成功后保存凭据并将对应模型提供方加入 DSH 模型目录。
dsh-plugin-subhub 的订阅模型目录：登录后从账户服务读取模型清单，并在设置界面展示模型名称、上下文窗口、图片输入能力及可用推理档位。
dsh-plugin-subhub 的图片生成与编辑：在已登录 OpenAI 账户时调用 generate_image 工具，输入图像描述生成新图，或选择编辑最近对话图像并返回图片结果。
dsh-plugin-subhub 的本地凭据管理：各提供方使用插件自己的凭据文件，可通过 authFile 设置路径；OpenAI 令牌会在请求前检查有效期并按需刷新。
dsh-plugin-subhub sends login and model requests to provider services; credentials stay in local plugin files.

dsh-plugin-subhub README · Introduction：Bring a **third-party subscription account** into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) and chat with the models your subscription covers: text chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing.

**Supported today: OpenAI / ChatGPT, xAI (Grok), and GitHub Copilot subscriptions — all signed in with your subscription account through browser authorization. Key-based services are already built into DeepSeek Harness — add them on its Models page.**

dsh-plugin-subhub README · Introduction：> Model availability, usage limits, and response speed are decided by the subscription provider and your account. Some features may become temporarily unavailable after the provider changes its service.

dsh-plugin-subhub README · Install：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) with Node.js 22.19 or later.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kinoward/dsh-plugin-subhub
dsh web
```

`dsh web` boots the `web` profile (same as `dsh --profile web`). Restart DeepSeek Harness after installing.

dsh-plugin-subhub README · Quick start：1. **Log in** — open **Settings → Third-party subscriptions**, click **Sign in** on the card of the subscription you want (e.g. **OpenAI subscription** for a ChatGPT account or **xAI Grok subscription** for SuperGrok / X Premium+), then open the authorization link in a browser and enter the one-time code (valid for 15 minutes). Once authorized, the page syncs automatically and the subscription appears in the model picker.
2. **Pick a model** — click the model selector at the bottom-left of the input area (it shows the current model and reasoning level), choose **Model**, and pick a model under **OpenAI subscription**. Adjust the reasoning level from the same menu if needed. Available models and reasoning levels come from your account and stay in sync automatically.
3. **Use images** — upload an image and ask about it, describe an image to generate one, or ask to edit an image:

dsh-plugin-subhub README · Quick start：- View: *“What's in this image?”* / *“Extract the text from this screenshot.”*
   - Generate: *“A cinematic illustration of a neon street on a rainy night.”*
   - Edit: upload an image (or use the one just generated), then *“Change the sky to a sunset, keep everything else the same.”* The edit uses the most recent image in the conversation; upload one first if there is none.
dsh-plugin-subhub README · Quick start：Viewing, generating, and editing images all require a model that supports image input; the model info marks it with an “Image input” tag.

dsh-plugin-subhub README · Manage your account：- **Re-login / log out** — **Settings → Third-party subscriptions** → **Log in again** switches accounts; **Log out** removes the saved login.
- **Update** — rerun the install command, then restart DeepSeek Harness.
- **Disable** — **Settings → Plugins → Plugin list** → turn off `dsh-plugin-subhub`.

dsh-plugin-subhub README · CLI sign-in (optional)：No graphical interface? Sign in with the bundled script instead. From the profile directory, run:

```sh
node node_modules/dsh-plugin-subhub/login.js
```

dsh-plugin-subhub README · CLI sign-in (optional)：The script prints an authorization link and a one-time code — open the link in a browser, enter the code, and the credentials are saved to `~/.dsh-plugin-subhub/openai-auth.json`. After signing in, open **Settings → Third-party subscriptions** once so the subscription appears in the model picker. The bundled script currently covers OpenAI; every other provider signs in on the subscriptions page.
